title: Web Export: Higher values of low_processor_usage_mode_sleep_usec increase CPU usage
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.1

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.rc (1ae4d3b23) - Freedesktop SDK 24.08 (Flatpak runtime) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 (nvidia) - AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 30.39 GiB memory

### Issue description

The [documentation](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_os.html#class-os-property-low-processor-usage-mode-sleep-usec) claim that higher values of `OS.low_processor_usage_mode_sleep_usec` make the CPU usage lower, but the inverse seems to be true.

A value of 100 makes the CPU usage drop to like 1%, and a value of 1,000,000 makes it spike to 100%. Even the default of 6900 seems like too much.

Looking at CPU usage in htop running a linux export, however, at a value of 100 it's 20% CPU usage and 1,000,000 it drops to near 0, which is what I'd also expect of the web app. So at least for desktop it seems to be fine.

It seems that changing `Engine.max_fps` will also spike the CPU to extreme levels. E.g. `Engine.max_fps = 60`, likely because they both contribute to `get_frame_delay()`.

### Steps to reproduce

- Export the app for web or use the pre-exported one
- Run the app (e.g. python -m http.server and open localhost:8000)
- Open developer tools to monitor CPU usage
- Tick the checkbox. CPU usage should spike dramatically.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[cpu_spike_project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26284354/cpu_spike_project.zip)

The code being used for reference
```gdscript
extends Node

@export var checkbox: CheckBox

func _ready() -> void:
	OS.low_processor_usage_mode = true
	OS.low_processor_usage_mode_sleep_usec = 100
	checkbox.toggled.connect(_on_toggled_checkbox)


func _on_toggled_checkbox(value: bool) -> void:
	if value:
		OS.low_processor_usage_mode_sleep_usec = 1000000
	else:
		OS.low_processor_usage_mode_sleep_usec = 100
```
